label: keysWhenAnimated: an animated row's write lands on frame 0, the base, not the playhead
find: keying.setValue(value, for: p, of: id, at: f, in: &doc.compositions[i])
replace: keying.setValue(value, for: p, of: id, at: 0, in: &doc.compositions[i])

label: scaleAboutCentre: the layer is placed by the box's top-left, not its centre
find: let centre = HaloPoint(x: (t.box.minX + t.box.maxX) / 2, y: (t.box.minY + t.box.maxY) / 2)
replace: let centre = HaloPoint(x: t.box.minX, y: t.box.minY)

label: dragIsOneStep: a drag's writes don't fold into one step
flipWritesNegativeScale: the flipped box's mirror is dropped, so Scale X stays positive
mirrorReadsNegativeScale: a negative Scale Y doesn't read as a vertical mirror
